item.title: Coming up Saturday on Around the House Show!
item.description: AI is changing construction and remodeling in America — and right up front we dig into how machine smarts are speeding up the slowest part of every project: design and estimation. We promise, there won’t be a robot under your sink installing plumbing tomorrow, but these tools get homeowners real, region-priced numbers fast, keep contractors honest, and shave off a ton of admin so builders can stop living in spreadsheets... Feed: https://feeds.captivate.fm/around-the-house-with-e/
